name: run_id
description: Unique identifier for one CI run. The GitHub Actions run id when available, otherwise a locally generated uuid.

name: status
description: passed, failed, flaky, or skipped. flaky means the test failed and then passed on a retry within the same run.

name: duration_seconds
description: Wall-clock execution time. For a flaky test this is the total across all attempts.

name: run_timestamp
description: When the test started, UTC. Partitioning column.

name: branch
description: Git branch that triggered the run.

name: commit_sha
description: Commit under test. Beyond the fields listed in ARCHITECTURE.md section 4, because the first question a broken trend line raises is which change broke it, and a branch name cannot answer that.

name: retry_count
description: Attempts beyond the first. Also beyond section 4's list: flaky-test frequency is far more actionable when a test that needed one retry is distinguishable from one that needed three.

name: marker
description: pytest marker the test carried (smoke or regression), so trends can be split by suite tier.
